title: Step VII: Add E-D and Ignore E-G

blocks.content: Step VII: Add E-D and Ignore E-G
Add E-D to the Spanning Tree
The next lowest-cost edge is 12 connecting edges E and D. Adding them to the tree does not form a cycle.

blocks.alt: Add E-D to the Spanning Tree

blocks.content: Ignore E-G as it forms a cycle.
